note: Reconstructed from the Lane 2 typed client and the Next.js compatibility proxy. The canonical Go chat schema (Lane 1) had not landed in go/ at capture time; cells depending on the real store are marked pending-lane1.

ids.sessionId: client-minted `s-<uuid>`; proxy must not mint (breaks command-id replay)
ids.commandId: client uuid; replay key for persist-before-ack receipts
ids.turnId/chatAttemptId: canonical, assigned by the Go writer

invariants.persist-before-ack: a SendTurn receipt exists only after the canonical commit; a retried command id replays the original receipt
invariants.command-id-replay: same commandId + same sessionId => same receipt, exactly one turn row
invariants.single-writer: the Go side owns writes; the proxy is a pure forward and is never a second writer; legacy writer only behind SEN_CHAT_LEGACY_WRITER=1, never dual-write
invariants.seq-dedupe: stream events dedupe by (chatAttemptId, seq); a refetched tail never double-renders (mergeEventsBySeq)
invariants.gap-refetch: hasEventGap(lastApplied, incoming) detects a lost seq; client refetches from after_seq
invariants.attempt-lease: attempts carry leaseOwner + leaseGeneration; state machine queued|claimed|running|succeeded|failed|cancelled|no_response
invariants.loopback-token: Go listener is loopback-only with shared token from sen.env; a non-loopback host disables the proxy instead of leaking
